*** 3-BED HMO INVESTMENT OPPORTUNITY ***

Freshly painted and sitting proudly on the top floor, this bright and spacious three bed flat is an ideal opportunity for anyone looking for comfort, convenience, and a smart long term investment. With generous proportions throughout and an open, airy feel, it’s a home that instantly makes a great impression.

The large lounge is the heart of the property — a brilliant space with room for both relaxing and dining, flooded with natural light. From here, step out onto the private balcony, perfect for morning coffees, evening unwinds, or simply enjoying the open aspect that gives this flat its uplifting vibe.

A separate kitchen keeps the living space calm and clutter free, offering good storage and practical worktop space for everyday cooking.

All three bedrooms are true doubles, each benefiting from fitted storage to keep things streamlined. Whether you’re planning to rent to students, accommodate professionals, or create a flexible home with office space, the layout works beautifully.

A well presented bathroom completes the interior, offering a clean and functional finish.

Located close to Robert Gordon University and within easy reach of local amenities, transport links, and green spaces, this flat is perfectly positioned for students and professionals alike. With strong rental demand in the area, it also represents a fantastic investment opportunity for landlords seeking reliable returns.

Fresh, spacious, and superbly located — this top floor gem is ready to move into or rent out with ease...

so if you’re thinking “this looks perfect,” trust me — so is everyone else. Get your viewing locked in now and beat the rush.
WELCOME HOME
LOCATION :
 Garthdee is a well established residential area situated within easy reach of the city centre. The area offers excellent local amenities including recreational facilities, a health centre and a wide range of shops at the Bridge of Dee Retail Park. The AWPR is 5 minutes’ drive away giving quick access to the west and north of the city. There is regular public transport nearby. Walkers, runners and cyclists are well provided for with easy access to the Deeside Way and riverside walks along the Dee.

Some photos have been virtually staged for reference only.
